name: cert-paste-check
title: Cert Paste Check
description: Identifies certificates, private keys and CSRs in a paste and catches a chain out of order or missing its intermediate, expired or expiring certificates, a hostname the SANs don't cover, self-signed certificates in production and a non-matching key.

mistakes: private key does not match cert
meta.summary: Tells a certificate, key and CSR apart as they're pasted and catches chain, expiry, hostname and key-mismatch mistakes before a TLS install breaks.
meta.server: Validate the full chain and key on the server or in your TLS tooling before deploying; this is a paste-time check.
catches: A private key or CSR pasted where a certificate was expected
A chain out of order or missing its intermediate
A hostname the SANs don't cover, including wildcard and CN-only traps
A self-signed certificate in production, and a private key that doesn't match
limits: Parses the DER structure only; signatures are not verified and revocation is not checked
Does not check that the root is trusted by browsers
Everything runs in the browser, but a pasted private key is still sensitive: avoid logging the field
a11y: Labelled textarea with aria-invalid and aria-describedby to the hint and report
Summary in a role="status" region; serious problems use role="alert"
After a fix, focus moves to the next fix or back to the field
Severity shown with icons and text
